arena: [생존기] Divine Protection can be used while stunned and reduces damage taken by 20% for 8 sec. Pop it immediately when burst comes in while you're stunned.
[생존기] Divine Shield, Lay on Hands, Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Spellwarding all leave Forbearance for 30 sec, so you can't chain them on the same target. Plan who gets what first.

[분담] Blessing of Protection blocks physical damage for 10 sec, and Blessing of Spellwarding, which shares its cooldown, blocks magic damage. Pick based on whether the enemy hitting your ally is melee or a caster.

[해제] Cleanse removes all magic, poison and disease effects. Dispel magic CC on allies first. With Cleanse the Weak, the same effects are also removed from 1 ally within 40 yds, but the cooldown increases by 4 sec.
[제어] Hammer of Justice stuns a target within 10 yds for 6 sec. Lock down an enemy DPS when they pop burst cooldowns.
[제어] Searing Glare replaces Blinding Light and makes enemy players in a 25 yd cone miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec. Use it when multiple enemies burst at the same time.

[광역 피해] With Divine Vision, aura range increases by 30 yds and Aura Mastery's cooldown drops by 30 sec. During the enemy burst window, use Aura Mastery with Devotion Aura to reduce your team's damage taken by 12% for 8 sec.

[위치] Divine Steed increases movement speed by 100% for 3 sec, and Blessing of Freedom grants immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec. When slowed, use these to break line of sight behind a pillar.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 2 healers, and on flag maps a durable, mobile healer is a good flag carrier. You can take the carry with Divine Steed and Blessing of Freedom on yourself.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than healing it back, prevent the damage first with Blessing of Protection, Blessing of Spellwarding or Blessing of Sacrifice.
[분담] With Spreading the Word, Blessing of Freedom removes movement impairing effects from all allies in your aura. Use it when the flag carrier and escorts are slowed together.
[제어] Searing Glare makes multiple enemies in a 25 yd cone miss for 4 sec. Aim it at enemy packs rushing a base or your flag carrier.
[해제] With Cleanse the Weak, targets healed by Flash of Light or Holy Light are cleansed of all diseases and poisons. Keep cleansing through heals while Cleanse is on cooldown.

Blessing of Spellwarding, picked by 31 of 48 Solo Shuffle players, blocks magic damage and harmful effects for 10 sec. Searing Glare, picked by 30 of 42 Battleground Blitz players, makes enemies in a 25 yd cone miss for 4 sec.
